title: No session id / invalid session id
description: A first turn without any session id, and a turn carrying an id the store has never seen. Both must answer normally and hand back a live session id — an unknown id is never an error (a truly expired session behaves the same way and is covered by tests/unit/use_cases/test_load_session_use_case.py).
